subject: COBOL words
notes: kb/Work PB1086 (registrar 15b). Rule: `OK §8.3.2.2 3)` "The following user-defined words shall be externalized to the operating environment:" + `OK §8.3.2.2 1)` "program-names of outermost programs, object-class-names, function-prototype-names, interface-names, method-names, program-prototype-names, property-names, and user-function-names". VERIFIED: (1) outermost program-names — separately compiled EXSUBP.dll is reached by CALL 'exsubp' from another compilation unit (out/probe/extern/exmain2.cob -> `IN EXSUBP`), through ProgramTable rule 4 plus the sibling-module probe; a contained program is NOT externalized (§11.10.3 SR2 `OK §11.10.3 2)` "Literal-1 shall not be specified in a program that is contained within another program." -> COBOL1795) and the run-unit clash check exists (COBOL2213, PB660 landed). (2) user-function-names and function-prototype-names — FUNCTION-ID EXFN IS PROTOTYPE in exmain2.cob resolves to the separately compiled EXFN.dll -> `FN=4242`. (3) within ONE compilation group, class/interface/program/function names externalize through the AS phrase (pb303 goldens, conformance:cases/8.3.2.2-User-defined-words/pb974_repository_as_phrase). NOT VERIFIED / GAP: object-class-names (and by the same path interface-names, method-names and property-names) are NOT externalized ACROSS separately compiled units — out/probe/extern: CLASS-ID. EXCLS compiled alone to EXCLS.dll, then exmain.cob `REPOSITORY. CLASS EXCLS.` + `INVOKE EXCLS 'HELLO'` -> COBOL0823 'EXCLS is neither a resolvable data item nor a class this source element may reference'; the compiler adds no metadata reference but the runtime (RoslynBackend) and has no external-repository surface (§8.13 `OK §8.13` "The implementor shall provide a mechanism that allows the user to specify whether to update the external repository when a compilation unit is compiled."), so a class name reaches the operating environment only inside the compilation group that defines it. That residue is filed as finding F-OO-XUNIT (its root is §8.13, not this sentence). Program-prototype-names: the §12.3.8 program-specifier path (BinderDriver.ProgramPrototypesOf) is witnessed by conformance:cases/10.6-COBOL-compilation-group/pb894_program_prototype_2002, not re-probed here. PARTIAL: half the listed kinds verified across units, the OO half only within a group. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 85 (program-names of outermost programs only — the other kinds do not exist before 2002), 2002, 2014, 2023 retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Control/ProgramTable.cs#Resolve (ProgramTable declares no Resolve; the externalized-name resolution is its call path (CallProgram, EntryOf, Cancel))
